How are you feeling about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's a mix of relief and uncertainty. I'm glad to have more time for myself, but I worry about my career."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's completely normal to feel both relieved and anxious. Taking care of your mental health is crucial though."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"You're right. I've been trying to focus more on painting, as it helps with my stress."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's wonderful. Engaging in a hobby can be so therapeutic. Have you noticed any changes in how you feel since you started painting?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yes, definitely. It's like I can express what's inside without words, but sometimes the pressures of work still get to me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like painting has become an important outlet for you. It's okay if work stress still creeps in; what matters is that you have ways to cope."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks, I keep reminding myself of that. It's hard not to feel like I'm falling behind sometimes."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I understand. You've been through a lot with work and relationships. You're doing your best, and that's enough."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I try to remember that. The therapy sessions have helped too. I just worry about Mark being in the hospital; it brings back old anxieties."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's tough seeing someone you care about struggle. Have you managed to talk to Mark or visit him?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I did visit him. It was really hard, but I think he appreciated the company. I just wish I could do more."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Sometimes being there is enough. You're a good friend, and your support means a lot to him."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks. I just hope he knows that he's not alone."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sure he does. Keep taking care of yourself too; you need your strength to support others."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I will. Cutting back on work is a start, I suppose."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It absolutely is. It's a brave decision, and shows you're prioritizing your well-being."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Sometimes I just doubt if I'm doing the right thing."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Doubt can be part of the process, but remember that prioritizing yourself isn't wrong."}]
